Area.evidence_source: i. I'm going through a bad patch at the moment. The e-mail begins with an expressive speech act, conveying low mood. ii. About 5 years ago I tried to take my own life . . . This is followed by an assertive, informing of a past suicide attempt shortly after they split up. With hindsight, this may have been an indirect way of introducing his current suicide ideation. Bringing up a subject as taboo as suicide is potentially face-threatening for both parties, so the writer employs a range of mitigating, or face-saving, strategies.The writer implies an intention to move towards the future, which was interpreted by the recipient as disconfirming the possibility of any extant suicide ideation.
